question: Which state government started the 'Shantala Natya Sri Award' in 1995 in the field of classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Shantala Natya Sri Award** was initiated by the **Karnataka State Government** in **1995**.
 
• This award is dedicated to the field of **classical dance** and is named after **Queen Shantala**, who was a renowned patron of art and culture.
 
• Queen Shantala was the wife of **King Vishnuvardhana** of the **Hoysala dynasty** and was known for her exceptional contributions to the promotion of art forms, especially dance.
 
• The award aims to honor and recognize excellence in the domain of **Indian classical dance**, which includes forms like **Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kuchipudi, and Odissi**.
 
• Karnataka has a rich cultural heritage and a strong connection to classical art forms, making it an ideal state to institute such an award.
 
• The **Shantala Natya Sri Award** is one of the most prestigious recognitions in the field of dance and serves as a motivation for artists to preserve and promote traditional Indian dance forms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Assam**__

 __
 
• **Assam** is known for its traditional dance forms like **Bihu** and **Sattriya** (one of the eight classical dance forms of India).
 
• It is a northeastern state of India with a rich tradition of art, culture, and music.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh**__
 __
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is renowned for its classical dance form **Kuchipudi**, which originated in the state.
 
• The state has a long tradition of promoting classical arts and culture.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is the birthplace of **Bharatanatyam**, one of the oldest classical dance forms of India.
 
• It has a rich tradition of temple dances and classical music, especially associated with the temples of **Chidambaram and Thanjavur**.
